correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, the two cylinder inequalities give L=2/√(1−min(|Ux|,|Uy|)^2). The exact inequality in azimuth/height is z²+(1−z²)|sin 2q|<h. For 0<h<1 there are exactly four disjoint sectors, with constant area Jacobian h^(3/2), giving independent uniform marks and the exact arcsine slice width. The inequality arcsin x≥x and the denominator 1−hb²≤1 show genuine nesting. Expanding the half-width uniformly yields w_h−w_0=(h/2)b²(1−b²)+O(h²), and hence excess area (4/15)h+O(h²). Uniform measures on nested sets decompose into a common and a mutually singular excess term; the latter weight is exactly TV and its expansion is h/5+O(h²), not only O(h). Normalizing the twice-half-width excess yields height density converging uniformly to (15/4)b²(1−b²); sign is uniform and the magnitude converges uniformly to (1−b²)/2, proving weak shell convergence. The boundary limit is singular and not a shell TV limit. Independent support and quadrature checks and finite moment checks passed.
